design_goal: A compact, original countryside region for the first playable slice.

regions.name: Willow Village
regions.description: A quiet village of painted wooden homes, gardens, and a small central square.

regions.name: Sunmeadow Fields
regions.description: Open grassy fields, winding paths, orchards, and gentle hills.

regions.name: Old Mill Road
regions.description: A curving rural road connecting the village to an abandoned water mill.

regions.name: Mistwood Edge
regions.description: A friendly forest boundary with tall trees, streams, and hidden footpaths.
